svg.title: All the gates: one set for money, another for safety

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: All the gates: one set for money, another for safety

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Cost gates · per kind, not a total; all off by default

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Safety gates · whether it may, the model does not decide

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Three token gates, each with its own ledger

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Main chat · deep-dive · cross-book. Overspend on deep-dive cannot kill the turn you are in.

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: All three default to 0 = unlimited

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: 0 is not conservative: it is the regression guarantee. Leave them blank and behaviour matches the pre-cap build byte for byte.

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: ⚠️ the main-chat cap is not hard

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: On the cap, that tool batch is skipped, but the closing shot still fires — otherwise the spend is wasted.

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Hitting the cap is not an error; one sentence goes to the model

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Stop reading other books. Answer from what you have, and say which passages you saw.

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Deep-dive count gates

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: 8 per session · 40 per hour · concurrency 2 · stop when 3 sit unanswered.

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Cross-book character gate

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: 24,000 characters / 8 reads per turn; tool-loop cap 100.

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Sessions expire; the ledger goes with them

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Empty sessions: 1 day · chatted: 7 days · pending approval: 30 days. Purged on start.

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: sidecar only binds loopback

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: When the plugin starts it, only 127.0.0.1 / localhost / ::1; anything else is not-loopback.

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Sandbox: two sets of roots

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Write: only the registered note. Read: may widen to a whitelist. .git · .obsidian · .env* refused.

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Permissions are three-valued, no fourth

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: read_file → allow; fetch → allow; edit_file → ask every time; any other name → deny.

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: read-first hard gate

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: To edit a passage, an earlier turn must have really read that file. Same-batch read+edit is blocked too.

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Approval gate

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Landing on disk is always your click. Deny: not one byte moves.

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Data does not leave .pen

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Sessions · snapshots · quotas · deep questions stay on this machine; outbound is only your model endpoint.

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: The two limit tables must not drift

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: 18 knobs: LIMIT_SPEC in TS and LIMIT_RANGE in config.py are compared by npm test.

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans',Helvetica,Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: Settings clamp, they never error — a bad number must not kill this turn.
